findings.identity_explanation: Tag CH-02 matches exactly in CR:CH-02, ES:CH-02, FM:TFM-0105, COM-03 line 12 and WAR-04 line 9. Model PC-AC900, serial PCA9-20418 and location Roof agree wherever stated; no possible tag matches or correspondence were reported.

exceptions.finding: WAR-04 states no expiry date (Expiry: Not stated, Start: See terms). Working from the terms: 12 months from delivery on 14 September 2025 gives about 14 September 2026, which is before the 24 November 2026 handover date, so the warranty appears expired at handover. This assumes the 12-month term from delivery applies. A 24-month-from-commissioning extension was only discussed at a meeting and no written extension is attached, so it is not evidence (Evidence 2.3). Commissioning date 2026-10-14 would give a different expiry only if that extension were confirmed in writing, which is unknown.

exceptions.next_action: Request a corrected warranty certificate with an explicit start and expiry date, and either the written 24-month extension from commissioning or confirmation that the 12-month term from delivery applies (Readiness 5.2).

findings.summary: CH-02 identity is consistent across all registers and documents, and commissioning (COM-03, Pass, Signed), FM record, O&M manual and PPM plan all pass. The warranty WAR-04 gives no expiry; on its stated terms it appears to have expired around 14 September 2026, before the 24 November 2026 handover, and the discussed 24-month extension is not in writing. Written confirmation is needed from the manufacturer via the contractor.
findings.clarification_to: Halvorn Contracting project manager (for Brisel MEP Services and Polaris Cooling)
findings.clarification_subject: CH-02 chiller: warranty expiry date and extension confirmation (WAR-04)
findings.clarification_body: Dear Halvorn Contracting project manager, warranty certificate WAR-04 for chiller CH-02 (PC-AC900, serial PCA9-20418) states 'Expiry: Not stated'. The terms give 12 months from delivery (delivery note DN-4471, 14 September 2025), which would end before the planned handover on 24 November 2026. WAR-04 also mentions an extension to 24 months from commissioning discussed on 3 March 2026, but no written extension is attached. Please ask Polaris Cooling, through Brisel MEP Services, to issue a corrected warranty certificate stating the start date and expiry date, and to attach the written extension if it was agreed. Thank you.
uncertainties: Whether the 24-month extension was agreed is unknown; only a meeting discussion is cited.
Expiry of about 14 September 2026 is derived from the stated terms and is an assumption pending written confirmation.
Delivery note DN-4471 itself was not available to read.
